indications: Pigment Control Creme is indicated in the gradual bleaching of hyperpigmentation, skin conditions such as chloasma, melasma, freckles, senile lentigines, and other unwanted areas of melanin hyperpigmentation.
contraindications: A thin layer of Pigment Control Creme (Hydroquinone USP, 4%) should be applied to the affected area twice daily or as directed by a physician. If no improvement is seen after 8-12 weeks of treatment, use of this product should be discontinued. There is no recommended dosage for pediatric patients under 12 years of age except under the advice and supervision of a physician.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Pigment Control Creme (Hydroquinone USP, 4%) is available as follows:
                  2.7 Fl. Oz. (80 mL) Bottle / NDC 42851-037-80
                  1.0 fl oz/30 ml Bottle / NDC 42851-037-30
adverseReactions: Prior history of sensitivity or allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients. The safety of topical Hydroquinone use during pregnancy or in children (12 years and under) has not been established.
